name: valuerank
description: ValueRank research workspace and static publication pipeline

scripts.refresh:external: python3 -m valuerank.fetch_livebench && npm run capture:tb4 && python3 -m valuerank.build_tb4 data/tb4-scrape.json data/tb4.json
scripts.build:publication: npm run build:docs && npm run generate:og
scripts.refresh: npm run refresh:external && npm run build:aa && npm run build:scores && npm run reconcile:aa && npm run build:publication
scripts.verify:docs: VALUERANK_NOW=$(node -p "require('./data/ranking_summary.json').observedAt") npm run build:docs && git diff --exit-code --stat -- README.md methodology.md scores.md raw-data.md site data
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:js
